authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises - SRI Fund / NVCFL
interpretation: This packet records first-party source observations for reviewer use. It does not approve the authority, opportunity, eligibility rule, benefit, window or publication status.
sourcePolicy: The official NVCFL scheme page and portal control the SRI structure and route. Ministry annual-report material provides government programme context and the Startup India Playbook is discovery-only. SRI's indirect daughter-fund route must remain separate from direct founder benefits.

records.sourceAnchor: NVCFL scheme page: Introduction, Objectives, SRI Fund Structure, Investment Process and eligibility/exclusion conditions
observations: The official NVCFL scheme page describes SRI as a Category-II mother fund supporting empanelled Category-I/II daughter funds for onward MSME equity or quasi-equity growth capital.

MSMEs defined under the MSMED Act, as amended from time to time, are eligible for consideration, while non-profit institutions, NBFCs, financial-inclusion entities, micro-credit entities, SHGs and other financial intermediaries are excluded on the published page.
The NVCFL daughter-fund interest route is for prospective daughter-fund empanelment and must not be presented as a direct MSME investment application.
The published INR 10,000 crore government provision and approximately INR 50,000 crore leveraged structure are fund-level figures, not an individual applicant entitlement.
The public sources do not establish an individual enterprise ticket, valuation, dilution, governance, exit terms or guaranteed investment. The record remains paused and review-gated.

supportingSources.observation: The official NVCFL portal presents SRI as growth capital for high-potential MSMEs and provides current notification and contact context.

supportingSources.anchor: Show Your Interest as Daughter Fund
supportingSources.observation: The published route is for prospective daughter-fund empanelment and must not be presented as a direct MSME investment application.

supportingSources.anchor: Section 1.10.2: SRI Fund objective and structure
supportingSources.observation: The Ministry annual report confirms the Government-backed equity fund-of-funds objective and the need to distinguish fund-level corpus from individual benefit.

supportingSources.anchor: Special Measures under Aatmanirbhar Bharat: SRI Fund and NVCFL implementation context
supportingSources.observation: The Ministry annual report provides official implementation context and historical programme status, which still requires current reconciliation before publication.
The Playbook is discovery evidence for viable MSMEs and startup MSMEs; it is not treated as the sole operational authority.

Reconcile current programme-status figures before displaying any impact metric.

publicationGuard.reason: Official NVCFL and Ministry sources support a structured SRI draft, but current intake, daughter-fund availability, investment terms, amendments, authority mapping and applicant-specific conditions remain unresolved.
